messages:
Sam: Quick ops ask — Nimbus marketplace listing + case study quote need final creative/legal signoff. Two things: partner logo variants + alt text, and customer quote anonymization/legal ok. Pinging @Maya @Leo @Anita. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/nimbus-marketplace Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExample
figma-bot: Uploaded frames: /Landing_v3, /CaseStudy_QuoteDraft (see Figma link above)
Leo: On logos — I'll produce SVG + 1x/2x PNGs in color + white. Suggested padding: 24px min. Will export as `nimbus_logo_{color,white}.{svg,png}` by EOD.
Maya: Quote needs a tiny edit — customer asked to remove org name (NDA). Can we anonymize to "an enterprise customer" and keep the impact line? Anita, ok?
Anita: Legal: anonymizing is fine but we must remove the line mentioning "on-prem rollout in Q1" — too specific/attribution risk. Also need a signed publicity release. If they can't sign, we must paraphrase high-level. Uploading redline to Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Example
Sam: Timeline check — we plan to go live Thursday EOD. Need final assets + legal thumbs-up by Wednesday noon to leave time for QA.
Leo: Understood. I'll also add an `alt_texts.txt` with short alt text for each asset. Example alt text for wordmark: "Nimbus Systems logo — blue wordmark". Any objections?
Maya: That alt text is fine. Also note accessibility item: add alt text to marketplace metadata and run color contrast for buttons.
Anita: One more brand constraint from partner: no background watermark use and minimum lockup size 16px. See partner guideline doc: https://partners.example.com/nimbus/guidelines.pdf
Sam: @figma-bot can you export marketplace tile 300x200 png for QA and drop to the Drive folder as `landing_tile_300x200.png`?
figma-bot: Export complete — https://figma.com/file/abc123/exports/landing_tile_300x200.png
Leo: CTA color checked: #0B57D0 on white => contrast ratio 5.1:1, good. I'll attach final assets to Drive and note filenames in the playbook checklist.
Maya: I'll chase the customer for the signed release and the approved paraphrase of the quote. If I don't have it by 11am tomorrow, I will ask legal to approve the paraphrase form we discussed.
Sam: Great. Final deliverables we need: 1) logo package (svg/png white+color), 2) alt_texts.txt, 3) anonymized quote + signed release (or paraphrase approval), 4) exported tile png for QA. Target: Wednesday 12:00pm. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Leo: On it — updating Figma components and exporting now.
Anita: Will review final paraphrase when Maya posts it.
Maya: Will post customer response here when I have it.
